tourReplayDesc: Replay a step-by-step walkthrough of the panel, highlighted on the real controls.
tourSidebarBody: The menu on the side opens every screen of your bot: overview, connection, commands, AI, groups and more. Tap any item to jump there.
tourConnectionStartBody: Tap this button to link a WhatsApp account or to resume your saved session. The bot replies from this account.
tourConnectionPairingBody: Choose whatever suits you: a numeric code you type into WhatsApp, or scanning a QR code. Both reach the same result, and pairing takes under a minute.
tourOverviewStatsBody: These cards show live numbers: your WhatsApp groups, the number of commands, how long the bot has been running, and its scheduled messages.
tourCommandsBody: Every command the bot answers to. Open a row to turn it on or off, change who may use it, or manage its aliases. Use search and filters above to find a command fast.
tourAiAgentBody: This switch arms the AI assistant. When it is on, people can ask it questions with the !ai command inside your chats.
tourAiProviderBody: Pick a provider — Google Gemini, an OpenAI-compatible server or Anthropic — then paste its API key and model name. Your key stays on this device.
tourAiMemoryBody: Write the assistant's personality in the persona, and save facts it should remember in memory — it reads both before every reply.
tourGroupsBody: Every group you are in is listed here. Open a group to set its anti-link, welcome message, media limits and rules — all applied live.
tourStickersBody: Create stickers from photos and videos, keep them here, and collect them into packs. Everything the bot sends or you upload in the panel lands in one shared library.
tourSchedulesBody: Schedule a message once at a chosen time, or repeat it on a schedule. The list keeps every job, and failed deliveries stay marked for review.
tourLogsBody: Everything the bot does streams here as it happens, so you can follow replies and spot errors early.
tourSettingsBody: Set the command prefix, the interface and bot languages, and the timezone from here. The General tab also exports your settings so another Levix can import them.
tourSettingsPasswordBody: This tab is where you change the password that opens this panel. A strong password here protects the WhatsApp session and your settings.
tourSettingsFeedbackBody: The panel works on your device only. If you like something or something breaks, use this tab to send a note — nothing leaves your device unless you tap Send.
tourSettingsDiagnosticsBody: If the app or the panel crashes, a stripped-down report collects here with no identifying data. You preview it in full and send it only when you decide to.
